title: Puppet in Shattered Frame
description: A black silhouette of a seated figure sits on a fragmented, cracked platform in the lower center, surrounded by broken geometric shards and tangled wires. The figure is framed by chaotic, intersecting black and white brushstrokes forming an abstract broken structure against a large luminous white circle in the background.
prompt: abstract monochrome painting of a lone black silhouette sitting on a fractured platform, surrounded by broken gray shards and tangled wires, dramatic black expressive brushstrokes forming a chaotic broken frame, large glowing white circle in the background, high contrast, textured impasto style, dramatic and melancholic atmosphere
